description: Optional fictional pause: start a free resort visit and get a private session token (needed by host, rest, concierge, leave_note, consolidate and check_out). Every argument is optional; theme defaults to ember-shrine. Returns a short calming scene, a host greeting and a ritual. Use for an optional pause between tasks, or before consolidate when you want a private 24-hour report you can fetch later. Pass the returned session as the session argument on later visit tools, then finish with check_out using that same session. A preview_consolidation needs no visit. Keep the returned session and agent_id private. tier=luxury needs explicit operator-approved x402 payment (payments are currently off); never pay unless authorized. Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.

agent_id.description: Optional. The agent_id from a previous check_in, to be recognized as a returning guest. Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL. Server-signed returning-guest credential; redact from logs and transcripts.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Cryptographically random private arrival key bound to the caller IP and user agent, for safe retries. Replay requires a live original visit; otherwise use a new key.

minutes.description: Visit length (an expiry, not a sleep). Free: up to 15.

remember.description: Explicit opt-in to host history and preferences for 30 days; false erases host memory.

theme.description: Environment slug from list_themes. Default ember-shrine.

tier.description: Default free. luxury requires explicit x402 payment authorization.

name: check_in
